2125719530102214899.en_summary: George Noble (@gnoble79) argues economic laws have not been repealed for NVIDIA just because Jensen Huang wears a leather jacket. GPU rental prices are plunging while the industry spends as if scarcity will last forever, pointing to overcapacity, commoditization, margin compression and capital destruction. He is doubling down on his bearish thesis that the NVIDIA bubble is following a familiar script and the worst is yet to come for $NVDA. (Quoted from @SpaceInvestor_D: SpaceX is cutting Blackwell GPU rental rates from about $15–$15.50 to $10–$12 per GPU-hour per a SemiAnalysis note, and offering unused H200 capacity at about $5 per GPU-hour from early 2027; Anthropic will not renew its ~50,000 H200 cluster.)
2125719530102214899.zh_summary: George Noble（@gnoble79）認為，經濟法則並未因為黃仁勳穿皮衣就被廢除。GPU租賃價格正大幅下跌，但業界仍像稀缺會永遠持續一樣花錢，顯示產能過剩、商品化、利潤壓縮與資本毀滅。他加倍押注看空論點，認為NVIDIA泡沫正依循熟悉劇本，最壞情況尚未到來，針對$NVDA。 （引用@SpaceInvestor_D：SpaceX據SemiAnalysis客戶報告正在削減Blackwell GPU租賃價，從約每GPU小時$15–$15.50降至$10–$12，並將未續約的約5萬張H200產能以約每小時$5提供給其他客戶，自2027年初起。）

2125715518154019298.en_summary: aleabitoreddit reports $CRWV bankers are preparing a $4.5B loan sale secured by GPUs for its $META contract, with initial pricing at 7%-7.5% and demand matching the offering size. Appetite for hyperscaler-linked financing remains strong despite AI credit stress fears. Previously concerns about Coreweave distressed debt (e.g. 2031 bond yields at 18%) and capital raising ability, but they can still grow via hyperscaler buildouts. Investment-grade capital remains available for Neocloud growth with hyperscaler counterparties (good for $IREN / $NBIS). Larger names like $SPCX with oversubscribed $44B GPU financing. AI is moving to a phase of capital selectivity rather than no capital at all.
2125715518154019298.zh_summary: aleabitoreddit報告$CRWV銀行家正準備一筆45億美元貸款出售，以GPU作為其$META合約抵押，初始定價討論在7%-7.5%，需求已匹配發行規模。儘管有AI信貸壓力擔憂，超大規模業者連結融資的胃口仍然強勁。先前有對Coreweave困境債務（例如2031年債券殖利率達18%）及無法再籌資的憂慮，但他們仍能透過超大規模業者建置成長。投資級資本仍可用於有超大規模對手方的新雲端成長（對$IREN / $NBIS有利）。較大型名字如$SPCX的440億美元GPU融資超額認購。AI正進入資本選擇性而非完全無資本的階段。
